utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Kira, is the drive ready yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Almost, but I need to double-check a few things first. Are you sure we're good to go?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm sure. Let's just get it done.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope we have a good system for tracking borrowed tools—Gus offered to make a sign-out sheet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great idea! Vik will be thrilled to have a sign-out sheet—he's been worried about keeping track of everything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, a sign-out sheet will really help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara! I'm so glad you're here to help with the repair drive. Shall we go over the plan?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I'm ready to help. Let's review what we need to do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great! I've got the list of households that requested repairs. Let's start by sorting the urgent ones.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I think it's to fix up some of the old houses around here. Did we talk about this already? Sorry, I can't quite remember.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who's organizing it then?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, how's the repair drive coming along? I saw some folks working on it earlier.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's going well! Remember, it's all happening this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll make sure to stop by on Saturday then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for organizing this. I'm sure it will help a lot of folks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's no trouble! And don't forget, Gus brings tools for the drive. My porch chair's leg is wobbly, so I'm hoping he can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm glad Gus is helping. My garden gate's been sticking something awful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Eli, I heard something about a repair drive? What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, it's a community event where we fix broken items together. It's happening this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I have an old toaster that's been sitting around. Do I just bring it along?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus, what's this about the repair drive again?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's this Saturday—I'm bringing tools for folks to borrow, with a sign-out sheet so we keep track.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Saturday. I'll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The repair drive? What exactly does that involve?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late—what's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries, Dane. I was just asking about the repair drive—what's the scope of work we're looking at?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Noah brought duct tape, screws, and a hammer for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh good, did he put them in the toolbox by the garage?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, he placed them there this morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah, I was thinking about the repair drive—how do you want to schedule it with the school calendar?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I spaced out. What were we planning exactly?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's a community event where folks bring broken items to be fixed, like bikes or small appliances. I was thinking we could tie it to the next PTA meeting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam, have you heard about the community repair drive this Saturday? We need all the help we can get!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I hadn't heard about it, but I'd love to help out! What needs to be repaired?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! We're fixing up old furniture and appliances at the community center. Can you bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got Noah down for duct tape, screws, and a hammer. That should cover the basics.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect! Gus is bringing his tools too, so we should have everything. Say, do you think someone could take a look at my porch chair? It's got a wobbly leg.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Ask Noah if he can fix it — he's got the hammer and screws for that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, you heard about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've heard. I think it's happening at the community center on Elm Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's the one. I heard they're collecting tools and spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not entirely sure, but I heard someone mention it's for fixing up the community garden tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So are we bringing our own tools or are they provided?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's this repair drive about, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's a community event where folks bring broken items and I lend out tools to fix 'em. Happening this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds interesting. Do you need any help setting up or just spreading the word?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I saw the flyer. Not sure I'll make it though.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, come on! It'll be fun and we really need more hands. Can I count you in?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, have you thought about when we should schedule the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I reckon Saturday is the day we've got it set for, so no need to change that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday works great. What time were you thinking? I need to check with the school's calendar.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Sam! What's this about a repair drive? I think I forgot something...

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Oren! The neighborhood repair drive is happening this Saturday. I wanted to see if you still needed help fixing that fence of yours.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the fence! I completely forgot. Yes, I could really use some help with that. What time on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? Can you tell me more about what needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure about the full list, but Gus has tools and he can make a sign-out sheet to keep track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Gus will handle the tools and sign-out sheet. Do we have a list of items that need repair, or should we start gathering from neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Bo. Did I miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not much, just waiting for the repair drive to start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good, Quinn saved a rake for me, so I'm ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Jules, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, Vik is helping organize a repair drive for the neighborhood! I'm planning to drop by after lunch to see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a repair drive? That sounds like a good idea. Maybe I'll swing by too, if I can remember.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Leo! I heard about the repair drive. Are you planning to join?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. Got some tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great! I'm making a list of who's bringing what, so I'll add you down for tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is on the up and up? I don't want to get involved in anything shady.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh honey, I personally vetted everyone involved — it's all above board, just neighbors helping neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but you're sure? I just need to hear it from someone else too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
